headline: Kerch Strait transit ~100% below its pre-disruption norm (sustained)
brief_md:

_This is a persistent disruption, not a fresh blip. A 28-day rolling baseline has since adapted to the new level, which is why a same-day anomaly detector reads it as 'normal'; it is flagged by comparing today's level to the pre-shift norm._

_Method: sustained level-shift vs pre-disruption norm. Source: IMF PortWatch — daily granularity, refreshed weekly._
